facts.business: Indergiri Finance Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India engaged in lending operations.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Proposing to augment the NOF through a rights issue of equity shares aggregating to INR 1,000 Lakhs and to achieve compliance by 31 March 2026.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Net Owned Fund (NOF) compliance via Rights Issue

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpt
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified Opinion due to non-maintenance of minimum Net Owned Fund (NOF) of INR 500 Lakhs as per RBI Scale Based Regulation; NOF stood at INR (64.19) Lakhs as at 31 March 2026. Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern due to risk of cancellation of Certificate of Registration by RBI.

key_risks: Regulatory non-compliance with minimum Net Owned Fund (NOF) requirement of INR 500 Lakhs
Risk of cancellation of Certificate of Registration (CoR) by RBI
Material uncertainty related to going concern
Failure to complete proposed rights issue of INR 1,000 Lakhs
